column1: # Built-in TTS pronunciations, seeded once into the `tts_lexicon` table
# (source 'default'). Runtime edits go through Settings → Voice or the
# voice assistant's `voice_pronunciation` tool, not this file; a word listed
# here is only ever seeded once, so a user edit or delete always wins.
# One entry per line: <word as displayed> <phonemes>. Phonemes use misaki's
# US alphabet as Kokoro consumes it (single-symbol diphthongs: A=/eɪ/
# I=/aɪ/ O=/oʊ/ W=/aʊ/ Y=/ɔɪ/, ʤ ʧ), with ˈ primary and ˌ secondary stress
# right before the stressed vowel. Only symbols in kokoro_vocab.json are
# allowed (a unit test enforces it). Spaces split a pronunciation into
# separately spoken words. Acronyms follow misaki's own letter-by-letter
# style: every letter secondary-stressed, the last primary.
